offline-first-run: a first run on a machine with no model and no network.

kb init with the default model tries to fetch the model. Offline that fails after the store is
created, and kb says so (exit 2). The proxy variables point at a dead port, so the attempt fails
fast. The exact network error text varies, so the test matches that line by pattern.

  $ kb init
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5)
  [stderr] kb: downloading embedding model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 to $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/models (once per machine)
  [stderr] ~ warning: download model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5: .*
  [stderr] kb init: loading model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
  [stderr] kb init: the store is created, but the model could not be loaded: model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 is not downloaded (run `kb model pull`)
  [exit 2]

  $ exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

Adding needs the embedder too, so nothing is copied. Search never downloads: it falls back to
full-text search (exit 2) and names the fix. The store is empty, so there is nothing to find.

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  [stderr] kb: downloading embedding model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 to $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/models (once per machine)
  [stderr] ~ warning: download model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5: .*
  [stderr] kb add: embedder not usable, nothing copied: model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 is not downloaded (run `kb model pull`)
  [exit 2]

  $ ! exists data/tmux.md

  $ kb search "tmux logout" --caller claude
  search 1 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=1
  [stderr] warning: embedder unavailable (embed query: model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 is not downloaded (run `kb model pull`)); falling back to --mode fts
  [exit 2]

  $ kb model list
  BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5                     768 dims  not downloaded
  BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5                    384 dims  not downloaded (default)
  nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5            768 dims  not downloaded
  sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2    384 dims  not downloaded

  $ kb model path
  $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/models/BAAI--bge-small-en-v1.5

  $ ! exists $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/models/*

The way out without a network: switch the store to full-text only (the config file is rewritten
here; `kb config --path` says where it is), then reindex (the index was built for the old model) and add.

  $ write .kb/stores/default/config.toml @fts-only

  $ kb reindex --all
  entries: 0 scanned, 0 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 0; embed calls: 0
  [stderr] embedding model mismatch: this database was indexed with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384 dims) but this run uses none (0 dims); rebuilding the index

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data/tmux.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb search "tmux logout" --caller claude
  search 2 · 2 hits
  [1] data/tmux.md · updated 2026-02-01
  Tmux survives logout: Keep sessions alive after you log out of the remote host.

  [2] data/tmux.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Tmux survives logout › (intro)
  # Tmux survives logout

  Start `tmux new -s work` on the remote host and detach with Ctrl-b d. The session keeps running
  after logout, and `tmux attach -t work` brings it back.
  search_id=2

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "data" (entries)
  ok   driver: fts5 enabled, sqlite 3.53.4, sqlite-vec v0.1.6
  ok   embed_meta: model=none dim=0
  ok   model: none: FTS-only index and search
  ok   entries: 1 entries valid
  ok   db-vs-files: 1 entries in sync
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 0 failed, 0 warnings

title: Tmux survives logout
summary: Keep sessions alive after you log out of the remote host.
tags: [terminal]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Tmux survives logout

Start `tmux new -s work` on the remote host and detach with Ctrl-b d. The session keeps running
after logout, and `tmux attach -t work` brings it back.
-- @fts-only --
# Full-text search only: no model, no download.
version = 1

[embed]
model = "none"

[[sources]]
path = "data"
layout = "entries"
